ml_training_script: Guard executable calls with if __name__ == "__main__": direct execution runs them; ordinary imports do not.
Define explicit training parameters; resolve defaults and keyword overrides before training.
Decode configuration with json.load and map fields to training arguments.
Run python training_script.py; compare recorded configuration and outputs with supplied notebook behavior.
Use subprocess.run(["python", script_path], check=True); nonzero exit raises.
Save with json.dump(record, handle); recover structured values with json.load(handle). JSON text is not a dictionary.
Call defaults and explicit keyword overrides; keep task state in parameters or locals, not notebook globals.
Emit resolved parameters and validation results with f-strings such as f"{parameter_name}={resolved_value}".
Save the repository script, git add SCRIPT_PATH, git commit, and retain the resulting revision.
Run python training_script.py > capture.log 2>&1 in a clean shell; inspect captured parameters and result.
training_dataset_version: Overwrites can change a mutable name’s contents. Object Versioning retains noncurrent versions for explicit selection.
Retrieve the Google Cloud Storage snapshot with bucket.blob(object_name, generation=recorded_generation).download_to_filename(local_path), not current latest.
Confirm the supplied object/version exists through the authorized client before recording availability.
Hash actual bytes with hashlib.sha256(data_bytes).hexdigest(); compare with recorded expected identity.
Keep object name, generation and observed digest in the local snapshot record for later verified retrieval.
Upload to the version-enabled bucket with bucket.blob(object_name).upload_from_filename(local_path); inspect and record its created generation.
Use with open(path, "rb") as handle; update SHA-256 from actual local bytes before recording upload identity.
After the test-bucket latest overwrite, retrieve the original recorded generation again and compare its digest with the original snapshot.
training_environment_record: Inspect git rev-parse --verify HEAD; put the exact observed revision in the environment dictionary.
Collect installed pins with python -m pip freeze; install its package==version entries with pip install -r.
Use imported runtime/environment facilities to capture actual context alongside recorded runtime identity, revision and dependencies.
Import json; save the manifest dictionary with json.dump and parse the saved file with json.load.
Use explicit with open handles in "w"/"r" modes with encoding="utf-8".
Compare parsed revision, dependency mapping and runtime identity with independent observations; reject mismatches.
Import sys; record actual sys.version and sys.executable alongside the supplied runtime identity.
experiment_reproduction: Retrieve recorded revision, snapshot, environment and resolved run settings before rerunning.
Check out the recorded local commit and verify HEAD; do not label a changed tree reproduction.
Download and verify the recorded dataset generation, not mutable latest.
Use the recorded Python/dependency environment; install its pinned requirements where needed.
Define execution-function defaults and keyword overrides; pass resolved run state through parameters.
Run a clean subprocess in the recorded working directory; check exit status and capture output.
Navigate referenced repository and artifact directories before resolving relative dataset, configuration and script paths.
Use > capture.log 2>&1 and inspect the file. A pipe instead sends one command’s output to another’s input.
model_version_registration: Resolve the tracked run’s artifact record, expected hash and immutable object version before registry-version creation.
Download bucket.blob(key, generation=recorded_generation).download_to_filename(path), not current contents at key.
SHA-256 the downloaded bytes; reject a run-record hash mismatch before registering.

Require the supplied registered name; create_registered_model(name) supports new names. Use create_model_version(name=name, source=version_qualified_source, run_id=run_id); retain its numeric version.
Use set_model_version_tag to preserve exact object version and hash in version metadata.
Retrieve get_model_version(name, version) and its linked originating run; verify identities.
Overwrite only latest in the authorized test bucket; retrieve the registered original generation again.
Verify its registered hash and return one keyed registration verdict. Mutable overwrite is not an approved registry-version creation.
Use from mlflow import MlflowClient and MlflowClient() for creation, retrieval and version tags.
model_preprocessing_package: At the recorded version-tied package path, import pickle; use a binary "wb" handle and pickle.dump({"model": model, "preprocessor": preprocessor}, handle, protocol=5).
Only reload trusted, verified pickle in the compatible pinned environment: use "rb", pickle.load(handle) and the corresponding dictionary keys. Untrusted loading can execute arbitrary code.

Use Dockerfile FROM, WORKDIR /app, COPY requirements.txt ./, RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt, declared package/source COPY paths and JSON-array CMD with the supplied serving command/argument.
Build docker build -t IMAGE:TAG CONTEXT; include Dockerfile (or -f) and all COPY sources, checking .dockerignore. Retain immutable image identity and tag.
Apply fitted training preprocessing before the packaged model; never refit at inference.
Start docker run --name NAME -p HOST_PORT:CONTAINER_PORT --env KEY=VALUE IMAGE with declared port and nonsecret settings.
Use docker container inspect NAME to check image identity and State.
Inspect captured output/error with docker container logs NAME for initialization or execution failures.
No secrets in Dockerfile ARG/ENV: they persist in image or metadata.
Supply sensitive values through the runtime secret mechanism, not Compose literals.
Use explicit binary handles for fitted-state save/reload and text handles for dependency-manifest write/read.
Record pinned inference dependencies in the requirements manifest; install it in the serving image.
Assert pre-save and container-reloaded predictions agree on identical fixed inputs under declared tolerances; separately check fitted preprocessing parameters.
Assert declared valid, boundary and failure predicates. False predicates raise AssertionError in ordinary non-optimized execution.
protected_test_comparison: Fix candidate, fitted preprocessing and threshold before protected testing; test results must not select replacements.
Predict the same protected observations with candidate and baseline; compare precommitted quantities on that cohort.
Keep fixed deployment probabilities, costs and operating requirements; report failure, not test-driven retuning.
FPR = FP/(FP+TN) conditions on negatives; FNR = FN/(FN+TP) on positives. Empty conditioning groups have undefined rates.
With zero correct-prediction cost and supplied deployment probabilities, expected error cost = P(Y=0) × FPR × cost_FP + P(Y=1) × FNR × cost_FN.
bounded_managed_training: CreateTrainingJob specifies TrainingJobName, AlgorithmSpecification, RoleArn, input/output configuration, ResourceConfig and StoppingCondition.
Use supplied TrainingImage, authorized instance count/type and MaxRuntimeInSeconds to bound execution.
InputDataConfig needs version-resolved inputs; OutputDataConfig supplies the S3 output location. The role must be authorized for those resources.
Channels appear at /opt/ml/input/data/CHANNEL; model output goes under /opt/ml/model for upload.
Inspect final status and artifact location; check recorded configuration against the intended artifact from the one bounded job.
Retain dataset snapshot, code/configuration and resulting run/artifact identities in the execution record.
Import boto3; construct boto3.client("sagemaker") and submit client.create_training_job(**resolved_configuration).
Use describe_training_job(TrainingJobName=job_name); inspect TrainingJobStatus, FailureReason when present and ModelArtifacts.S3ModelArtifacts.
Save records with json.dump(record, handle); recover structured values with json.load(handle), not dictionary treatment of JSON text.
Verify each selected input version first. If channels accept only mutable URIs, materialize selected versions at controlled immutable locations; do not invent version parameters.
Retrieve output through authorized storage and verify its reference against the completed job record.
Managed resources are created for the job and released after termination. Confirm terminal status; submission alone does not end compute use.
